card.name: Diet and disease-risk links in health text
card.fires_on: Words inside sentences about diet, alcohol, exercise or drugs and their links to disease risk, such as heart disease, cancers, stroke or hepatic adenomas. It sits on linking words and disease names just before or within the risk statement.
